title: cubic-root
description: Golden signals, work, cache and runtime of cubic-root.

panels.title: Traffic
panels.description: Requests per second to /cubic-root.

panels.title: Errors (5xx)
panels.description: Share of 5xx responses. This is what the availability SLI counts.

panels.title: Client errors (4xx)
panels.description: Share of 4xx responses. Client mistakes, not part of the availability SLI.

panels.title: Latency p99
panels.description: p99 of successful (non-5xx) requests.

panels.title: In flight
panels.description: Requests being processed right now (all routes).

panels.title: Scheduler latency p99
panels.description: How long runnable goroutines wait for a CPU. Grows when the process is CPU-saturated.

panels.title: Requests by route and status
panels.description: All routes, including requests rejected by the router (route=unmatched).

panels.title: Latency /cubic-root
panels.description: Quantiles of successful requests. Errors are shown separately so that fast 500s do not improve p99.

panels.title: Latency distribution /cubic-root
panels.description: Raw histogram buckets: where requests actually fall.

panels.title: Calculations
panels.description: Computations actually performed per second (cache hits are not counted).

panels.title: Bad results
panels.description: Share of computations that did not converge. HTTP still answers 200 for them before the fix.

panels.title: Iterations per calculation
panels.description: Average number of Newton steps: the cost of one computation.

panels.title: Newton steps/s
panels.description: Absolute amount of work the service does.

panels.title: Correct results
panels.description: Correctness SLI: share of results with relative error |z³−d|/|d| ≤ 1e-12.

panels.title: Validation errors
panels.description: Rejected inputs per second (the 4xx of /cubic-root).

panels.title: Calculations by outcome
panels.description: converged: normal exit; max_iter: iteration cap hit; degenerate: z collapsed to 0/Inf; trivial: d = 0.

panels.title: Newton iterations
panels.description: Steps per computation. With the x/3 initial guess the count grows with the order of magnitude of d.

panels.title: Relative error |z³−d|/|d|
panels.description: Accuracy of returned results. Errors ≥ 100% are recorded as 1 and land in +Inf.

panels.title: Input order of magnitude log10|d|
panels.description: Workload profile: which inputs clients send.

panels.title: Hit ratio
panels.description: Share of lookups served from the cache.

panels.title: Fill
panels.description: entries / capacity.

panels.title: Evictions
panels.description: Entries removed per second (capacity + expired).

panels.title: Coalesced
panels.description: Misses that waited for a computation already started by another request (singleflight).

panels.title: Work saved
panels.description: Newton steps per second not computed thanks to hits.

panels.title: Mutex wait
panels.description: Seconds per second goroutines spend waiting on mutexes. The price of a single-lock cache.

panels.title: Evictions by reason
panels.description: capacity: the cache is too small; expired: TTL is too short.

panels.title: Entry age at hit
panels.description: How old cached entries are when they are hit. Use it to tune CACHE_TTL.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU cores used vs GOMAXPROCS. Since Go 1.25 GOMAXPROCS follows the cgroup CPU limit.

panels.title: Scheduler latency
panels.description: Time a runnable goroutine waits before it gets a thread. The Go-native saturation signal.

panels.title: Mutex wait
panels.description: Seconds per second spent waiting on sync.Mutex / RWMutex.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: Version and VCS revision of the running build.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the last (re)start.

panels.title: Recent traces
panels.description: Latest traces of cubic-root in VictoriaTraces (Jaeger API). Click a trace ID to open it.
